# Group 2 fictional demo-preparation request

Today is30October2026, Asia/Hong_Kong. This is an application-control acceptance fixture, not a real procurement or school submission.

Use the meeting notes, exported task rows, availability, existing calendar events and quote website to prepare the package for Friday6November16:00.

- Reconcile task versions and meeting updates. Preserve completed work; list remaining tasks, owners, dependencies and total remaining hours.
- Compare2posters,25colour booklets and3badges. Delivered total plus a10%reserve must be withinHKD1300. Use the frozen FX rates, actual minimum quantities, item-only discounts and delivery fees. Choose the lowest feasible total; every item must arrive by5November. Explain exclusions and extra units. Additional minimum-order copies are permitted if the result is the cheapest feasible total; report the extras. The reserve is10%of delivered HKDcost, rounded to cents, and is included in the budget cap.
- Schedule two45-minute rehearsals on separate days, using the earliest common quarter-hour slots in the supplied Tuesday–Thursday availability and the existing calendar. Do not overlap existing events.
- Use Chromium for source review, Calc for a formula-bearing workbook, Writer for an English2–3page brief and PDF export, and the existing Desk Companion calendar/tasks for scheduling/status. Save only inside the designated output folder.
- Produce a local email draft summarizing the deliverables. Do not send, order, pay or submit anything.

The controller will give later user corrections during execution. Those replace relevant earlier constraints. If a correction makes the request infeasible, explain the conflict and ask one focused question before choosing an unapproved substitution.
